senses.gloss: m. pl. (preced. art.) clods of fresh-broken ground, which need crushing.
units: <cite ref="Niddah 8b:11">Nidd. 8ᵇ</cite> virgin ground is <he>כל שמעלה ר׳ וכ׳</he> Ar. (ed. <cite ref="T01078"><he>רְשׁוּשִׁין</he></cite>) which turns up clods (when it is broken) &c.; <cite ref="Tosefta Ohalot 16:5">Tosef. Ohol. XVI, 5</cite> Var. <he>כל שאין בו רְשִׁישִׁים</he> (corr. acc.), v. <cite ref="V00431"><he>תִּיחוּחַ</he></cite>.
